eventos.texto: Good afternoon, Clínica Arenal, you're through to reception. How can I help you today?
Hi, what's the earliest GP appointment please?
Entiende cuándo la quiere: lo antes posible
Could I take your full name, and either your DNI or NIE, or the phone number on your file?
Hay homónimos: pide un segundo dato
I have more than one Mario Garcia Lopez on file. Could you give me the date of birth?
Ficha encontrada: Mario G. (por DNI y nombre)
Ofrece el lunes 21 de septiembre a las 8:00 con el Dr. Andrés Sáez en Arenal Norte
Reserva · lunes 21 de septiembre, 8:00 · Dr. Andrés Sáez · Arenal Norte
Thank you, Mario, I have your record here. The earliest I have is Monday the 21st of September at 8 am with Dr. Andrés Sáez at Arenal Norte. Shall I book that for you?
